_comment: Example document vocabulary shipped as DATA, not source (P16 EP-387 neutrality gate).
These classifier keywords and extraction patterns are vertical-specific by nature — an
invoice, a prescription and a lab result belong to different industries. Baking them
into the SDK's TypeScript made sdk-parsing implicitly a healthcare/finance package, so
the next vertical would fork it rather than configure it.
As data they are a replaceable default: a tenant overrides them through sdk-taxonomy
(the production path), and a vertical can ship its own file. The SDK source now holds
only the MECHANISM — keyword scoring and regex extraction — which is genuinely neutral.
Nothing here is authoritative. taxonomy.extraction_schema wins whenever it resolves.
